# `aitbc tee keygen`

Generate a new TEE enclave signing key.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc tee keygen [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--key-file` | text | — | yes | Path to create (or read) a stable signing key at. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc tee keygen --key-file <key_file>
```
